summary_en: Introduces SonarLLM, a sonar-optical multimodal large language model with a sonar-specific encoder, modality-specific physics-aware feature enhancement, and reliability-aware hierarchical fusion. It also introduces SonarBench, a paired benchmark spanning recognition, counting, VQA, and captioning under controlled optical degradation, showing that sonar becomes increasingly complementary as turbidity degrades optical observations.
